evidence.model_evidence: Verified German QA/test vacancy sources: de.indeed.com (Indeed Deutschland) – direct QA vacancy cards reachable via crawl4ai for Berlin, Leipzig, Dresden; stepstone.de – direct QA listings and cards for Berlin, Leipzig, Dresden; germantechjobs.de – RSS feed providing direct QA cards for Berlin and Germany‑wide; adzuna.de – direct QA listing for Berlin (QM Prüfer) and city‑specific URLs; eurotechjobs.com – direct cards for QA roles in Berlin, Leipzig, Dresden.
